(IA No. 326579/2025 - CONDONATION OF DELAY IN FILING, IA   326583/2025 - CONDONATION OF DELAY IN REFILING / CURING   DEFECTS AND IA No. 326581/2025 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
 Date : 05-01-2026
This matter was called on for hearing today.

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K. VINOD CHANDRAN  For Petitioner(s) Mr. S. K. Patri, Adv.
 Mr. Amit Bardhan Mohanty, Adv.
 Mr. Vishal Arun Mishra, AOR  For Respondent(s) :

UPON hearing the counsel, the Court made the following  O R D E R Application for exemption from filing official translation is allowed.
Delay condoned.
Issue notice, returnable on 02.02.2026.
Notice shall be served by all modes, including dasti.

Subject to the petitioner, Gunsagar (Gunsagar) @ Raju Pasayat, joining and co-operating with the investigation in connection with 17:25:47 IST Reason:
First Information No. 239 dated 23.05.2022, registered with Police Station  Basna,
Gunsagar (Gunsagar) @ Raju Pasayat vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22732840/
1 District  Mahasamund, Chhattisgarh, for the offences punishable under Sections 294, 323, 506, 366, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 [as amended by the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Amendment Act, 2015], he shall not be arrested till the next hearing.
In addition, the petitioner shall scrupulously abide by the conditions stipulated in Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

(BABITA PANDEY) (PREETI SAXENA)
